rows.Origin:
Bred by Michèle Meilland Richardier (France, before 2012).
Introduced in Australia by Corporate Roses Pty. Ltd. in 2020 as 'Jazz Festival'.
rows.Bloom: Orange, pink shading. [Pink, yellow center.] Mild fragrance. 40 to 45 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, semi-double to double, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Dark green foliage.

Height: 35" to 43" (90 to 110cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Source: website alterarosa. Participant in the 2012 show
